profiles.label: Vanilla 3DGS SH PLY
profiles.input_contract: Standard binary_little_endian PLY with x/y/z, scale, rot, opacity, f_dc_* and f_rest_* fields.
profiles.serving_contract: Direct WebSplatServe export into base/refinement/spatial chunks.
profiles.deployment_role: Uncompressed or lightly processed baseline for Web delivery experiments.

profiles.label: Compressed backend decoded to SH PLY
profiles.input_contract: A compression backend such as HAC++, ContextGS or FCGS produces a decoded SH PLY or an equivalent materialized output.
profiles.serving_contract: Run WebSplatServe export after backend decode/materialization; report backend decode time separately if measured.
profiles.deployment_role: Shows that the serving layer can sit behind heterogeneous compression backends.

profiles.label: Compact/pruned SH PLY
profiles.input_contract: A pruning or compaction backend produces a lower-row-count SH PLY.
profiles.serving_contract: Use the same manifest/chunk protocol with stricter resident-row caps for mobile profiles.
profiles.deployment_role: Stress-tests row-budget adaptation without changing the browser runtime.
